name: Umicore SA
research_rationale: H1 2026 results and FY26 adj. EBITDA guidance above €1bn support the strong-buy case, but metal-price sensitivity, battery take-or-pay accruals and competitive cathode supply still temper full alignment.

weekly_updates.summary:
Sources refreshed 17 Nov; H1 2026 half-year filing (31 Jul 2026) remains in corpus with FY26 adj. EBITDA guidance raised to slightly above €1bn.  
News since 15 Sep is thin—valuation commentary and third-party Tesla cathode capacity; no new regulated results in the batch.  
Yahoo FY2025 FCF €386m and net debt €1.23bn; quarterly cashflow still empty so screen TTM FCF stays unverified.
